fusions.name: Migration Surge
fusions.desc: Drives a surge of water in a cone 5 tiles long ahead of you, dealing 12 damage to everything in it and knocking it back 3 tiles. Its damage rises 10% for each ally beside you, up to 40%.

fusions.name: Boxhorn Butt
fusions.desc: Butts the target with a horned brow for 7 damage, leaving it 8% easier to wound for 4 seconds. Costs 4% of your maximum health.

fusions.name: Move as One
fusions.desc: Every ally within 5 tiles strikes 15% harder for 12 seconds and fights with 1 more Power while it holds.

fusions.name: Herd Closes In
fusions.desc: When your health falls below 50%, you gain a shield worth 25% of your maximum health for 6 seconds. Its effect grows 8% for each ally within 5.5 tiles, up to 4 allies. Once every 30 seconds.
